item.title: AI Side Bar force-opens on startup, ignoring `workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility: "hidden"
item.body:
Setting `"workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility": "hidden"` has no effect. The AI Side Bar opens on every launch. Setting the same option to `"maximized"` is honored, which points at a force-open during layout start that overrides the `"hidden"` path.

**Steps:**
1. Set `"workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility": "hidden"` in settings.
2. Close the AI Side Bar and quit Trae.
3. Relaunch. The sidebar is open again.

**Expected:** Sidebar stays hidden, matching the setting and VS Code's behavior.
**Actual:** Sidebar opens every time and covers a large portion of the editor.

---

将 `"workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility"` 设置为 `"hidden"` 没有任何效果，AI 侧边栏每次启动都会打开。设置为 `"maximized"` 则能正常生效，这说明在布局启动阶段存在强制打开辅助侧边栏的逻辑，覆盖了 `"hidden"` 的行为。

**复现步骤：**
1. 在设置中加入 `"workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility": "hidden"`。
2. 关闭 AI 侧边栏并退出 Trae。
3. 重新启动，侧边栏再次被打开。

**期望：** 侧边栏保持隐藏，符合该设置以及 VS Code 的行为。
**实际：** 侧边栏每次启动都会打开，并占据编辑器的大片区域。

comments.body:
This appears to be a bug in Trae. The setting "workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility": "hidden" should prevent the Auxiliary Bar from opening, but Trae seems to force the AI Side Bar open during startup, overriding the setting.

As a workaround, I created a small open-source extension that automatically closes the Auxiliary Bar on startup by calling VS Code's built-in workbench.action.closeAuxiliaryBar command. It doesn't rely on any internal APIs or hacks—just the official command exposed by VS Code.

You can find it here:
https://github.com/MorgsBougie/HideAIPanel

Hopefully this helps until Trae fixes the underlying issue.
